**Restore the Werkzeug 3.1 binding inputs.**

With `Werkzeug>=3.1`, an empty `default_subdomain` becomes `None`. `bind_to_environ` then derives the request subdomain, so a `tenant.example.com` request can match a `subdomain="tenant"` rule while `subdomain_matching` is disabled.

When `host_matching` is enabled, passing `SERVER_NAME` makes `MapAdapter.match` compare host rules with the configured server name instead of the request host. Pass `server_name=None` for host matching and restore `default_subdomain or ""`. Add regression tests for both paths.
